faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Freelander Si4 use?
faqLeft.a: The Freelander Si4 uses the Ford EcoBoost 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol engine, fitted to the L359 generation from 2006 to 2014.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Freelander Si4 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £1,900. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Freelander Si4?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild Ford EcoBoost Freelander Si4 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain components, coolant system parts and gaskets as standard on every Freelander Si4 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Freelander Si4 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Freelander Si4 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Freelander Si4 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Freelander owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
